Overview of Zug Region (Zug)

Zug Region (Zug) is located in the Zug region of Switzerland, with its prefectural capital at Zug. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Historic Altstadt / Old Town, Panoramic mountain & lake views, Marked SwitzerlandMobility hiking trails, Local heritage museum.

RegionZug
Capital cityZug
Cities & municipalities10
Primary transport hubZug Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)

How to get to Zug Region

Connected via hourly SBB CFF FFS rail and PostBus services; fully covered by the Swiss Travel Pass. Use our SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Zug

When visiting cities across Zug, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Cheese fondue
  • Raclette
  • Rösti
  • Bircher muesli
  • Swiss artisanal chocolate

Best time to visit Zug

Best time to visit Zug: Jun–Sep (summer trails), Dec–Mar (winter sports).
